citeAs: Li, K., Wang, Y., He, Y., Li, Y., Wang, Y., Liu, Y., Wang, Z., Xu, J., Chen, G., Luo, P., Wang, L., & Qiao, Y. (2024). MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Video Understanding Benchmark. arXiv preprint arXiv:2311.17005v4.
creator: Kunchang Li, Yali Wang, Yinan He, Yizhuo Li, Yi Wang, Yi Liu, Zun Wang, Jilan Xu, Guo Chen, Ping Luo, Limin Wang, Yu Qiao
description: A comprehensive Multi-modal Video understanding Benchmark (MVBench) covering 20 challenging video tasks that require temporal understanding.
name: MVBench
publisher: Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences; Shanghai AI Laboratory
rai:annotationsPerItem: 200 multiple-choice QA pairs for each temporal understanding task
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: ChatGPT is used to generate a question for each video based on the task definition. Answer options are then created either directly from ground truth annotations (Template-Based Construction) or generated by ChatGPT (LLM-Based Generation).
rai:dataBiases: The authors state that using ground-truth video annotations to generate multiple-choice QAs guarantees evaluation fairness and avoids the biased scoring of LLMs.
rai:dataCollection: The dataset is built by automatically converting public video annotations from 11 existing video benchmarks into multiple-choice QAs using LLMs.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Videos from 11 public video benchmarks covering various complex domains and diverse scenes, ranging from first-person to third-person perspectives, and from indoor to outdoor environments.
rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Short clips and extremely long videos were eliminated. For the STAR dataset, start or end points of video clips were randomly shifted. For CLEVRER, questions requiring more than 10 conditions were excluded.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: For all questions, 3 to 5 answer options were randomly sampled and shuffled. An LLM was used to guarantee that all answer options for a question are of similar and reasonable lengths.
rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating the temporal perception capabilities of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in the open world.

null_reasons.rai:annotatorDemographics: No human annotators used for the new annotations.
